structural_faults.message: Node has no outgoing choices and is not marked as an ending. A reader who selects 'Go deeper into the darkness' at node_2 is permanently stuck.
No path from the start node reaches node_7. It forms an isolated cluster with node_8 but has no incoming edges from the main graph.
No path from the start node reaches node_8. It is only reachable via node_7, which is itself unreachable.

semantic_faults.message: Captain Volkov is presented as alive and unharmed in node_9. On path_2, node_3 establishes with certainty that Volkov died in an explosion before this point. The graph structure is valid — path_2 is a real path. But the story is not.

node_14 describes a voice speaking directly into the protagonist's mind, bypassing ears. The story's world rules explicitly prohibit psychic or supernatural phenomena. This is a realistic 1962 Cold War thriller.
Same world rule violation as sem_002. node_14 appears on path_4 as well. The psychic voice contradicts the established realistic setting on this path too.

valid_endings.prose_preview: You follow the outflow current up through a crack in the rock ceiling and burst through the surface...
Behind the far wall is a submarine pen, sealed and dry. The overhead lights still work...
